name: SignalCollector daily entity replay
primary_input: EntityRecord(rulebook+ticker), cache-only OHLCV, market history, sentiment
signal_output: SignalSnapshot with should_buy score threshold strength components price
limitations: Current context/data version may not match historical training context; parity gate required

name: build_signal_cache
limitations: Returns buy signals only; feature/label attachment must be added in research pipeline

name: Central portfolio backtester
continuous_or_holding_signals: signal cache contains all signals; trade output does not
limitations: Use signal_cache/candidate log for filter learning, not executed trade list

name: Daily signal replay lot probe
primary_input: saved Stage2 lots, topn rulebooks, OHLCV cache
signal_output: entry replay plus daily rows during each lot
continuous_or_holding_signals: only days inside already logged lots
limitations: Designed for entry parity and lot-level decay; does not sweep full history before/after logged lots

name: Stage2 training backtest
position_state_effect: trade simulator skips/suppresses new entries while holding
limitations: Can supply rulebook/period/data conventions but trade rows are entry-biased

name: Stage3 aggressive replay
position_state_effect: position state and exit path determine stored entries
limitations: Useful to locate exact historical rulebook/context, not all should_buy dates
